state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: The immediate stage is blinded human review of 22 unexposed questions. A later resource-contingent 750 NO plus 250 YES item design specifies a paired estimand, two-sided interval, five-point interpretation margin, failure rule and freeze fields. It would require at least 2000 independent first-pass judgments and about 4000 model generations; it is not frozen or run.
